open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    # Markers occur in pairs along the boundaries of a repeated tiled field.
    # Read each pair of adjacent marker positions and place its color in the
    # corresponding macro-cell of the reduced grid.
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (5, 8))
    rs = [r for r in range(H) if any(v not in (5,8) for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(W) if any(grid[r][c] not in (5,8) for r in range(H))]
    # Macro cell size follows spacing between repeated boundary lines.
    rh = min((b-a for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:])), default=4)
    cw = min((b-a for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:])), default=8)
    nr, nc = (H-1)//rh, (W-1)//cw
    out=[[8]*nc for _ in range(nr)]
    # Consecutive equal-colored markers encode one output cell; use their
    # boundary coordinate to select the corresponding reduced-grid position.
    for r in rs:
      vals=[(c,grid[r][c]) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c] not in (5,8)]
      for c,v in vals:
        y=min(r//rh,nr-1); x=min(c//cw,nc-1)
        out[y][x]=v
    return out
''')

    nr, nc = (H-1)//row_step, (W-1)//col_step

    specials = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (5,8)}

        r = y*row_step

            vals = [grid[rr][cc] for rr in (r, min(r+row_step,H-1)) for cc in (c,min(c+col_step,W-1))]
            v = next((a for a in vals if a in specials), None)
            if v is not None: out[y][x]=v
    return out
